nurse.text: Why aye, pet! Welcome to the Newcastle Sanctuary. Pop the team on the counter and we'll have them right as rain, which, aye, is the usual weather.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit yersel doon, pet. There's tea in the pot, a stottie on the plate, and a wind outside that could unseat a statue.
Aa done, hinny! Not a scratch, no a scuff. Mind how ye go, and mind the seagulls. They've been told you're the next one.
The Ark terminal's in the corner. It's powered by hot tea and stubbornness. Go on, pet, give us a click.

else.text: No bother, pet. Come back when you need us. We'll still be here, and so will the wind.
